title: alopecurus pratensis var. exserens
intro: Alopecurus pratensis var. exserens, commonly known as meadow foxtail grass, is a variety of perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in soothing digestive issues and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of meadow foxtail grass include its use as a demulcent, soothing the mucous membranes and protecting them from irritation. The bioactive constituents of meadow foxtail grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
